map.喝水提醒计划计算器是做什么的？: What does Daily Water Intake Planner do?
map.如何使用喝水提醒计划计算器？: How do I use Daily Water Intake Planner?
map.喝水提醒计划计算器适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Daily Water Intake Planner best for?
map.每天该喝多少水？输入体重、运动强度与当日气温，估算基础饮水量，再叠加运动与高温增: Estimate your daily recommended water intake from weight, exercise intensity and temperature, and generate a drinking schedule.
map.📖 查看「喝水提醒计划计算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "Daily Water Intake Planner Guide"
map.饮水目标 = 体重×30ml + 运动增量 + 高温增量 + 特殊增量: Water target = weight × 30 ml + exercise addition + heat addition + special addition
map.基础量按 30ml/kg（成人常见 30–35ml/kg 区间取下限）；运动增量: The base amount is taken at 30 ml/kg (the lower end of the common 30-35 ml/kg range for adults); the exercise addition is 0 / 200 / 500 / 800 ml by intensity; add 250 ml when the temperature is ≥25°C and 400 ml when ≥30°C; add 300 ml during pregnancy and 700 ml while breastfeeding. The total is then allocated across ten time slots from 07:00 to 22:00 to give a staged drinking plan.
map.按体重估每日饮水。: Estimate daily water intake from body weight.
map.夏季户外作业前按体重与气温估算每日饮水与分段计划，预防脱水。: Before outdoor work in summer, estimate daily water intake and a staged schedule from weight and temperature to prevent dehydration.
map.体重 70 kg × 35 mL ≈ 2.45 L/日（含食物水分约 30–40: 70 kg × 35 mL ≈ 2.45 L/day (including about 30-40 mL/kg from food).
map.要，按出汗额外补。: Yes; top up according to how much you sweat.
map.汤羹和水果算水量吗？: Do soups and fruit count as water intake?
map.通常食物可贡献约两成水分，页面按纯饮水目标估算，实际可把汤羹水果折算后略减饮水量: Food usually contributes about 20% of water; the page estimates a pure drinking-water target, so in practice you can subtract a little after allowing for soups and fruit.
map.基础量按 30ml/kg 估算（WHO 成人一般建议 30-35ml/kg）: The base amount is estimated at 30 ml/kg (WHO generally suggests 30-35 ml/kg for adults)
map.运动增量：轻度 200 / 中度 500 / 高强度 800 ml: Exercise additions: light 200 / moderate 500 / intense 800 ml
map.气温≥30°C 补 400ml，25-29°C 补 250ml: Add 400 ml when the temperature is ≥30°C and 250 ml at 25-29°C
map.分段计划覆盖 07:00-22:00，睡前 1 小时起少量饮水: The staged plan covers 07:00-22:00, with small sips starting 1 hour before bed
